constraints.source: I go to bed at 12:30 and get up at 8:30.
constraints.paraphrase: You usually sleep at 00:30 and wake at 08:30 every night.

constraints.source: No work after 11 though, I need time to wind down.
constraints.paraphrase: Never schedule any work between 23:00 and the morning.
You have the gym every Tuesday and Thursday from 18:00 to 19:00.
constraints.title: Gym
